job.job_description:
We are looking for a Junior AI Engineer with 6 months to 2 years of experience who is passionate about Artificial Intelligence and interested in building practical, real-world AI applications.The candidate should have hands-on experience with Python, AI/ML concepts, data handling, and web technologies. Exposure to Generative AI/LLMs and frontend frameworks will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and implement AI/ML solutions using Python.
Support data preparation, preprocessing, model development, testing, and evaluation.
Work with Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-based applications.
Develop and integrate AI solutions with web applications and frontend interfaces.
Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
Integrate and work with REST APIs and databases.
Debug, test, and improve AI/ML applications for better performance and reliability.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Collaborate with the technical team to solve real-world business problems.
Learn and work with emerging AI/ML and software development technologies.
Key Skills:
6 months - 2 years of relevant experience in AI/ML or software development.
Strong knowledge of Python and programming fundamentals.
Good understanding of AI/ML concepts, model development, testing, and evaluation.
Hands-on experience with NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn.
Good knowledge of Data Structures and Problem Solving.
Good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Exposure to React or Angular is an added advantage.
Good understanding of Generative AI and LLMs is preferred.
Knowledge of Prompt Engineering, RAG, or LangChain is an added advantage.
Good understanding of REST APIs and SQL/Databases is preferred.
Strong communication, logical thinking, and willingness to learn new technologies.
What We Offer - Trackmind
Opportunity to work on real-world AI/ML and technology projects.
Hands-on exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, and modern AI technologies.
Opportunity to work with experienced technical and engineering teams.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Exposure to enterprise technology and client projects.
Collaborative and supportive work environment.
Opportunity to build and strengthen your AI/ML and software development skills.
Career growth opportunities based on performance and capabilities.
What We Offer
Work Details:
Location: Hyderabad
Work Mode: Work from Office - 5 Days a Week
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 6 Months - 2 Years
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
